The '''floating archidia''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of flower that was native the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. The flowers were typically purple, blue or crimson in [[Color/Legends|color]], and they had a unique method of seed dispersal, whereby tiny, [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]]-filled sacs inside the flowers allowed them to float and travel in a breeze for several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], until the hydrogen sacs shrunk and their seeds were released. According to a rumor, the fragrance emitted by the floating archidia had a euphoric effect on those who inhaled it. The company [[PharmCorp]] secretly developed a method by which the pollen produced by the floating archidia could be concentrated to form an inhalant [[Poison/Legends|poison]].<ref>[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]</ref>
